import pennylane as qml
import numpy as np
from pennylane.qchem.quadratic import QuadraticProgram
from pennylane.qty import Qubit
from dwave.system.samplers import DWaveSampler

# Define QUBO variables and their corresponding workloads
qubo_variables = [Qubit(i) for i in range(9)]
workloads = [
    {"name": "W1", "priority": 5, "constraints": []},
    {"name": "W2", "priority": 4, "constraints": []},
    {"name": "W3", "priority": 8, "constraints": ["exclusive_resource"]},
    {"name": "W4", "priority": 6, "constraints": ["co_requirement", "constraints_from"]},
    {"name": "W5", "priority": 3, "constraints": []},
    {"name": "W6", "priority": 9, "constraints": ["exclusive_resource"]},
    {"name": "W7", "priority": 5, "constraints": []},
    {"name": "W8", "priority": 2, "constraints": []},
    {"name": "W9", "priority": 7, "constraints": []},
]

# Define constraints
constraints = []
exclusive_resource_constraint = qml.QubitOperator(0.5 * (1 - 2 * qubo_variables[3] * qubo_variables[6]), qubo_variables)
co_requirement_constraint = qml.QubitOperator(qubo_variables[3] - qubo_variables[2] * qubo_variables[3], qubo_variables)
constraints.append(exclusive_resource_constraint)
constraints.append(co_requirement_constraint)
for workload in workloads:
    if workload["constraints"]:
        for constraint in workload["constraints"]:
            if constraint == "constraints_from":
                workload["constraints"].extend(constraints)

# Define QUBO coefficients
full_qubo_linear = {qubo_variables[i]: -workload["priority"] - 108 + 12 if workload["name"] == "W4" else -workload["priority"] for i, workload in enumerate(workloads)}
full_qubo_quadratic = {
    (qubo_variables[i], qubo_variables[j]): 24 if i != j else -108 + 12 if i == 3 and j == 3 else -12 if i == 2 and j == 4 else 36 if i == 3 and j == 6 else None
    for i, j in itertools.combinations(range(9), 2)
}

# Define QUBO problem and solver
num_variables = len(qubo_variables)
num_constraints = len(constraints)
qpu = QuadraticProgram(num_variables=num_variables, num_constraints=num_constraints)
qpu.add_linear_coefficients(full_qubo_linear)
qpu.add_quadratic_coefficients(full_qubo_quadratic)
qpu.add_linear_constraints(constraints)

dwave_sampler = DWaveSampler(EmbeddingComposite([DWaveSampler(configuration='ADI_q8_2')]))

# Solve QUBO problem
result = qpu.minimize(dwave_sampler=dwave_sampler, max_time=3600)

# Extract results
feasible_objective_quality = result.objective / 31
constraint_violation_rate = result.constraint_violations / num_constraints
penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.value
runtime = result.time
evaluation_cost = result.num_evaluations
achieved_priority = sum([workload["priority"] for workload in workloads if result.variables[qubo_variables.index(workload["qubit"])] == 1])
admitted_workloads = [workload["name"] for workload in workloads if result.variables[qubo_variables.index(workload["qubit"])] == 1]

# Print results
print(f"feasible_objective_quality: {feasible_objective_quality}")
print(f"constraint_violation_rate: {constraint_violation_rate}")
print(f"penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy: {penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy}")
print(f"runtime: {runtime}")
print(f"evaluation_cost: {evaluation_cost}")
print(f"achieved_priority: {achieved_priority}")
print(f"admitted_workloads: {admitted_workloads}")
